units.source_text: 忽然听见廊下有一个非常娇嫩而美妙的声音，

en.t: Suddenly he heard an extraordinarily tender and beautiful voice from the corridor,

units.source_text: 迥非寻常女声可比，正在吟唱古歌：

en.t: quite unlike any ordinary woman's voice, chanting an old poem:
"It is not like a bright lamp shining, nor like a dark curtain drawn.

units.source_text: 朦胧春月夜，美景世无双。”[\[4\]](#part1337.html#m4)

en.t: On this hazy spring moonlit night, the beauty is without equal in the world."[\[4\]](#part1337.html#m4)

units.source_text: 这女子一面吟唱，一面向这边走来。

en.t: As the woman sang, she came walking this way.

units.source_text: 源氏公子喜出望外，待她走近，便闯出门去，一把拉住了她的衣袖。

en.t: Prince Genji was overjoyed; when she came near, he rushed out through the door and seized her sleeve.

units.source_text: 那女子好像很害怕的样子，叫道：“呀，吓死我啦！是谁呀？”

en.t: The woman seemed terribly frightened and cried, "Oh, you scared me to death! Who is it?"

units.source_text: 源氏公子答道：“你何必这样讨厌我呢？”

en.t: Prince Genji answered, "Why must you dislike me so much?"
